qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Low-cost Nordic hydro and nuclear generation assets are physically irreplaceable, but Fortum is a pure wholesale commodity price taker on Nord Pool with zero pricing power.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (REJECT). Nordic clean power generator operates as a wholesale price taker on Nord Pool. Returns on capital and cash flows fluctuate violently with volatile Nordic spot power prices, hydrological reservoir levels, and carbon allowance prices.
qualitative.evidence: Over 80% of comparable EBITDA stems from wholesale power generation (hydro and nuclear in Finland and Sweden). Because electricity is a commoditized product dispatched via merit order, Fortum has no ability to raise prices independently. Capital efficiency and ROIC swing cyclically with wholesale power prices and weather patterns.
